connector.name: HempData
connector.registryDescription: Verified hemp & cannabinoid regulatory data for all 50 US states + DC. Requires a HempData API key.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.hempdata.io over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace io.hempdata, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <HempData API key>. Get a key at https://hempdata.io/pricing (free tier available).
